name: How long does exterior house painting take?

mainEntity.name: How long does exterior house painting take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior house painting project varies based on the size and condition of your home, weather conditions, and the complexity of the job. A typical single-story home can take 3-7 days, while larger or more complex homes may require 1-2 weeks. Factors like extensive repairs, multiple paint colors, or inclement weather in areas like Abbott, Addison, Aledo, or Allen can extend the timeline. Discounted Roofing Co. aims to complete projects efficiently while maintaining quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior painting typically takes 3-7 days for a single-story home, or 1-2 weeks for larger homes. Project duration depends on home size, condition, complexity, and local weather.
